Keyboard shortcuts are quick key combinations that let you perform certain tasks in Thunderbird faster. For example, if you want to [[Archived Messages|archive a message]], you can simply strike the "A" key rather than using the mouse to click the option in a menu. Some shortcuts can be customized or disabled with the use of an add-on.

__TOC__

= About keyboard shortcuts =
In Thunderbird, keyboard shortcuts are context sensitive, which means that they vary according to the area of the Thunderbird interface that is currently "active". For example, when a message is selected in the message list, the Cut, Copy, and Paste keyboard shortcuts are disabled (because it doesn't make sense to cut and paste text into the message list). Similarly, if you select text while you are reading a message, the Copy shortcut is available, but not the Cut or Paste shortcuts (because while it makes sense to copy text from a message you are reading, it doesn't make sense to paste text into or cut text from a message you are reading).

The keyboard shortcut functions themselves may vary depending on the part of the Thunderbird interface that is active. For example, if you are writing a message, the {for win,linux}{key Ctrl+A}{/for}{for mac}{key Command+A}{/for} keyboard shortcut selects all the text in the message. However, if a message is highlighted in the message list, {for win,linux}{key Ctrl+A}{/for}{for mac}{key Command+A}{/for} selects all the messages in the message list.
{note}'''Note:''' Keyboard shortcuts consist of so-called modifiers (for example, {key Ctrl}) and alphanumeric characters (for example {key A}). In the documentation, shortcuts are written using the names of modifier keys (for example, {key Ctrl}) together with uppercase letters (for example, {key P}) or just alphanumeric characters (for example, {key K}). If a shortcut contains a modifier, its notation may look like this: {button Ctrl+A}. Shortcuts can include multiple modifiers and an alphanumeric character, for example: {button Ctrl+Shift+L}. This means pressing and holding the {key Ctrl} and {key Shift} keys, then pressing the {key L} key. If a shortcut contains only an alphanumeric character without a modifier key, please do not use the {key Shift} key, since in that case it only changes the alphanumeric character to uppercase.{/note}

= Shortcut keys and operating systems =
*On Windows and Linux, the shortcut modifier key is usually the {key Ctrl} key.
*On macOS, the shortcut modifier key is usually the {key Command} key.
*On macOS laptops, you must hold down the {key fn} key to enable the function keys {key F1} through {key F12}.

|Show Main Mail Window (Mail & Newsgroups)||{for win,linux}{key Ctrl+1}{/for}{for mac}{key Command+1}{/for}
|}

=Adding or changing shortcuts=
Some add-ons can add or change shortcut keys. For example [https://addons.thunderbird.net/thunderbird/addon/f9-hides-the-folder-pane/ F9 Hides the Folder Pane].

Keyboard configuration for changing shortcut keys is in progress for a future release.
